text: {"lessons":["My account has fallen from NT$104,325 to NT$91,489, so I should review whether my overall exposure and risk level suit me rather than ignore the decline.","I have made no trades, and the account has still moved substantially; trading less can avoid impulsive decisions, but I should check that my holdings remain consistent with my goals.","These month-to-month changes do not predict what comes next, so I should not chase a rebound or sell solely out of fear; I should make deliberate decisions based on my plan."]}
